capabilities: Auto-indent, close brackets and comment lines while typing in code blocks
Suggest names and expand live templates and postfix snippets
Show indent guides, coloured brackets, sticky headers and folding
Check code as you type and offer quick fixes on desktop
Format blocks, jump to definitions and rewrite code with a local AI model
disambiguation: Not a code runner; it edits and checks code inside code blocks, while running code is left to Tahoe Run.
extras: Desktop features run locally installed tools and write code to temporary files outside the vault; AI requests go only to Ollama on localhost. Developed and tested on macOS, with Windows and Linux support untested. No telemetry, accounts or payments. Other plugins can register completion providers through a public API.
problem: Code blocks in Obsidian are plain text, so there is no indentation help, completion, error checking or navigation while writing code in a note.

relations.evidence: With Tahoe Run: Python and MATLAB suggestions come from the note's running session
With Tahoe Intelligence: Apple Intelligence can be the model for ghost text, ⌘I and equation to code
With Tahoe: suggestion lists, hover docs and problem cards appear as solid, readable cards
The AI features use Ollama on your computer

requires.name: Language servers, checkers and formatters (clangd, Pyright, ruff, black, gofmt and others)

summary: Code-block IDE for notes: smart Enter and indentation, bracket closing, suggestions, live templates, sticky headers, desktop linting and AI edits.
